payload.body_they: People often get a clear sense of what {{Name}} likes before they know them very well. Their taste shows up in what they wear, choose, keep around them, and the people or places they are drawn toward. Other people may respond strongly to that, but approval cannot tell {{Name}} what they should keep choosing. Being wanted and wanting something themselves are different experiences.
